findings.note: cancelled connect closed the MongoClient once the driver connect finishes (test and open); confirmed in second-pass review
draft with id gets stored secrets only when connection string/auth/TLS/SSH match the saved profile
per-caller cancel for concurrent opens; connect closed when the last waiter cancels
conn.close during a connect answers CANCELLED
test() with an already aborted signal starts a connect before answering CANCELLED; client is closed, nothing leaks
SERVER_ERROR detail taken only from the top-level error, nested cause yields empty detail; not required by the contract
